name: Lamentations
author: Not named in the text. Tradition names Jeremiah.
date: After the fall of Jerusalem in 586 BC.
theme: Honest grief before God, who remains faithful even in judgment.

outline.label: The man who has seen affliction
Remember what has come upon us

christInBook: The grieving of Jerusalem points to Jesus, the man of sorrows, who wept over the city and who bore the full weight of judgment. The hope in 3:22-23, that the LORD’s mercies are new every morning, is fulfilled in him.
howToRead: Each chapter is an acrostic poem built on the Hebrew alphabet, and the third chapter is the center of the book. Read it as a model for honest grief that does not let go of God.
